Updates the requirements on [anthropic](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python) to permit the latest version.
Release notes

Sourced from anthropic's releases.

v0.121.0

0.121.0 (2026-08-07)

Full Changelog: v0.120.2...v0.121.0

Features

  • api: add mid-conversation-tool-changes-2026-07-01 beta (c7d1531)
